definitions.gloss: to issue; to publish; to release officially
definitions.explanation: To officially produce and distribute documents, cards, certificates, books, newspapers, stamps, or currency. Used for both physical and digital issuance.

examples.japanese: パスポートを{発行|はっこう}する。
{新|あたら}しいクレジットカードが{発行|はっこう}された。
examples.english: A new credit card was issued.

examples.japanese: この{雑誌|ざっし}は{毎月|まいつき}{一日|ついたち}に{発行|はっこう}されている。
examples.english: This magazine is published on the first of every month.

notes:
{発行|はっこう}する means to officially issue, publish, or release documents, cards, publications, or currency.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: [document]を{発行|はっこう}する

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- パスポートを{発行|はっこう}する: to issue a passport
- {証明書|しょうめいしょ}を{発行|はっこう}する: to issue a certificate
- クレジットカードを{発行|はっこう}する: to issue a credit card
- {株|かぶ}を{発行|はっこう}する: to issue shares
- {雑誌|ざっし}を{発行|はっこう}する: to publish a magazine

NOUN COMPOUNDS:
- {発行日|はっこうび}: date of issue
- {発行|はっこう}{部数|ぶすう}: circulation (number of copies)
- {発行元|はっこうもと} / {発行者|はっこうしゃ}: issuer, publisher

FORMATION:
{発|はつ} (emit/send out) + {行|こう} (carry out).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出版|しゅっぱん}する: to publish (books — more specific to book publishing)
- {交付|こうふ}する: to issue/grant (official documents — more bureaucratic)
